timeline.rule: every availability window starts and ends between 1 Jan 2025 and 30 Apr 2026; each aggregation template and each route scenario is dated as one episode (base day + 0/1-day offsets, windows share a common interval); every other donation gets an independent day (weekends x1.5); no other donation with the same reference hub and category starts or ends within 7 days of a batch episode; IDs are numbered in order of availability_start

study_area.description: Peninsular Malaysia (11 states + Kuala Lumpur and Putrajaya); benchmark points are sampled inside the 17 km road-extract window around each of the 11 NGOs

boundary.rule: donor, hub and NGO points must lie inside the state boundary; roads inside the states plus a 0.05 deg coastal band, minus Singapore (same rule as the app road network)

donor_sampling.method: Each locality gets a donor quota proportional to OpenDOSM district population (shared equally by localities in the same district) x proximity factor exp(-max(d-5,0)/19), d = km to the nearest NGO; each donor home is a distinct road node on a residential, living_street, service or unclassified street, within 5.5 km of the locality anchor and 25 km of an NGO.

localities.locality: Pertubuhan Kebajikan dan Penjagaan Kanak-Kanak Kurang Upaya Negeri Johor
Badan Usaha Didikan Anak Yatim Negeri Kedah (BUDI)

rules.road_network: directed OSM drivable graph; no straight-line fallback
rules.hub_sites: OSM amenity=community_centre or townhall, at most 18 per NGO window
rules.availability: opens 09:00-14:00; closes 17:00-21:00 the same day or up to 3 days later; lasts 8-72 h
rules.accepted_categories: all six; no furniture below 100 kg capacity; half of hubs decline one more category
rules.candidate_hubs: all hubs within 20 km straight line of the donor (backend geolock_donation_hub_routes)
rules.hard_feasibility: item compatibility AND capacity AND operating window (>= 30 min overlap of the availability window with the daily opening hours) AND hub active AND directed donor-to-hub route

reference_policy.distance: min-max normalised within the feasible group

rules.recommendation_scenarios: donations with at least two feasible hubs
rules.batch_templates: reference-policy hub; 3-5 donations, one category, <= 30 kg; one accumulation episode each; added_at = first opening-hours handover; members ordered by added_at then donation_id; created_at = last added_at

not_in_benchmark: experiment worker counts and lease duration
